main_text.head: CAPVT XIV. De Concione sive exhortatione funebri.
Ioannes Calvinus, in Epist. ad Monsbelgardenses, Lib. Epist. Col. 56.
main_text.p: I.IN Sepultura mortuorum hanc moderationem vellem adhiberi, ne in Templum funus deferretur, sed recta in cametErium. Illic quoque exhortationem haberi vellem, vt in re praesenti funeris comites agnoscerent quod diceretur. Haec ratio non admodum improbanda foret. De Campanae pulsu nolim vos pertinacius reclamare, si obtineri nequeat vt princeps remittat: Non quia probem, sed quia rem contentiosae non dignam arbitror.

Tria hic observa ex verbis Calvini: 1. Optarem distincta esse caemeteria, nec in Templis sepeliri mortuos; quod & nos optamus. 2. Vt, ubi deponitur funus, ibi fiat exhortatio funebris; & vicissim ubi fit exhortatio, ibi praesens sit funus. 3. Si quae sint non magni momenti, quae minus probemus, non tamen de eis pertinaciter contendendum.

page.notes: The first word "IN" of the opening is a large decorated initial "I" joined to "N". Some words in the first paragraph are printed with a tilde-like mark (e.g. "ne~", "quoque~") representing omitted letters; the printed "cametErium" is as printed. Marginal "I." at the right is a note mark. The text "IN" at the foot right is a catchword-like mark, transcribed in the foot paragraph; treat as doubtful.
